purpose: test whether concentration on a thin 15-name universe was the cause of the earlier positive result
universe: 66 NSE large/mid-caps with both daily and hourly coverage

luck_test.method: 25 random 15-name universes through the identical engine and cost model
luck_test.conclusion: the earlier +1.62% on 15 names was a lucky universe draw, not a robust signal. Random 15s also print positives (6/25) and the best of them reaches +1.67%, statistically indistinguishable from the original result.

why: no configuration on the 66-name universe clears the 6% cash hurdle
the earlier positive result does not survive a wider universe, so it was universe selection, not signal
strategy still beats beta on drawdown at every setting, which confirms the risk-control mechanism is real, but that alone is not a profit engine
revised_understanding: intraday execution reliably reduces drawdown versus holding overnight (confirmed repeatedly) but it does not manufacture return. Return magnitude remains the binding constraint across every instrument class and frequency tested.
